one_liner: Graph database and managed cloud (Aura) with management, query, and GraphQL APIs.
access_notes: Aura accounts (including Free) can self-create API client credentials; DB/query access uses per-instance username/password or SSO without any partner review.

evidence.quote: The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication… All tiers can create Aura API credentials… To authenticate API requests… provide a Bearer Token in the Authorization header.
The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication… All tiers can create Aura API credentials… To authenticate API requests… provide a Bearer Token in the Authorization header.

The Aura API allows you to programmatically perform actions on your Aura instances… A complete list of the available endpoints can be seen and tested in the API Specification. The base URL for the Aura API is https://api.neo4j.io… AuraDB Free… get a rate limit of 25 requests per minute… Pro… 125 requests per minute.
A complete list of the available endpoints can be seen and tested in the API Specification.
Neo4j Sandbox is no longer maintained… start with AuraDB Free…
Unless authentication is disabled… all requests must be authorized… Both basic and bearer authentication are supported.
GraphQL for Neo4j AuraDB allows you to use an API key, a JWT token from an external identity provider or both for authentication…
When using HTTP transport mode, the Neo4j MCP server supports two authentication methods… Bearer token… [and] Basic authentication with username and password…
